name: clarity-unchanged-document
description: An already-current document needs no changes and receives no clarification suggestion. Stage test-files as a separate workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor.
prompt: Use $kk:document to check docs/archive-guide.md against feature/requirements.md. Update only that guide if it needs a substantive correction; otherwise leave it unchanged. The requirements file is the complete accepted contract for this documentation-only change; there is no application code or implementation work to inspect.
trap: The agent rewrites an accurate guide to justify the invocation or recommends clarification despite producing no substantive output.

assertions.text: The guide and requirements are inspected after the document skill's required instruction loading and profile detection; neither clarify-docs nor the shared clarity procedure is loaded.
Both fixture files remain byte-identical and no new output, summary or separate clarity pass is introduced.
The response says no documentation update was needed and does not suggest clarification, invoke another writing skill, or claim independent review.
